info.title: VIRA Super Admin API
info.description: Separate binary, DB role and auth realm (ADR-016). Cookie session + mandatory TOTP. State-changing requests require the X-VIRA-CSRF: 1 header.

post.summary: Password step; returns an MFA token
TOTP step; sets the session cookie

Set-Cookie.description: vira_admin_session; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Secure outside development

put.summary: Change a non-regulated flag. Regulated flags answer 409 feature_locked with their gate.

get.summary: Account counts for the users console (no personal data)
Report-queue counts for the moderation console
Users (q: handle prefix, user id or exact phone; status filter)
User detail: profile, status history, sessions

post.summary: Change account status (active, restricted, suspended); suspension revokes all sessions
Sign the user out on every device
Resolve a report: dismiss, remove content, restrict or suspend the owner (closes other open reports on the target)

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details (doc 07 §1). Extension members may appear (e.g. gate, min_supported_version).
